setup: A lit constructed portal exists in a private cave known to be empty.
initial_audience_interpretation: Another player, forgotten work or an unexplained anomaly built it.
payoff: The protagonist mines local obsidian, builds the exact frame and watches his younger self discover it.
notes: Builder identity must resolve before the fire choice becomes the primary question.

setup: The ruined ravine repeats the same profile, tree line, stone drain and player-made alignments.
initial_audience_interpretation: It may be a copy or simulated future.
payoff: The bare portal site and visible younger self prove the destination is the same world at an earlier time.
notes: Use matched lenses and blocking rather than narration alone.

setup: The portal has an asymmetrical cobblestone foot and a torch on the unexpected wall.
initial_audience_interpretation: They are habits or mistakes of an unknown builder.
payoff: Water cooling produces the foot and the protagonist places the torch while working from the reverse approach.
notes: Both details must be legible in the opening without uniquely identifying him.

setup: Three red wool blocks point vaguely from the pen towards the eastern drain but have no arrowhead.
initial_audience_interpretation: They are abandoned decoration or a forgotten route marker.
payoff: The older self lays the interrupted warning, then later uses the same route during the rescue.
notes: The warning’s ambiguity results from his concealment decision, not damaged information.

setup: The ridge figure crouches twice to orient and places a torch on the left-facing wall.
initial_audience_interpretation: A knowledgeable stranger shares an oddly specific habit.
payoff: The protagonist deliberately repeats the exact action while drawing his earlier self back to the portal.
notes: Continuity requires identical count, side, position and camera silhouette.

setup: The wolf is seated behind a closed pen beside the eastern stone drain.
initial_audience_interpretation: It is safely left at home during an ordinary mining trip.
payoff: The seated state prevents self-evacuation, so the protagonist must reach the pen and release it through the drain route.
notes: Do not resolve by unexplained teleportation or autonomous escape.

setup: A visible air-and-stone gap separates the contained lava shelf from the existing timber maintenance stair.
initial_audience_interpretation: The lava is environmental texture kept at a safe distance.
payoff: Hurried spruce staging closes the gap; fire later traces through that addition into the stair and house.
notes: Mechanic, geometry and timing require target-version testing before lock.

setup: The burned pen is open and empty, with no direct evidence of the wolf’s death.
initial_audience_interpretation: The protagonist and audience fear that the wolf was lost.
payoff: The wolf is rescued and then concealed below the ridge during the earlier viewpoint.
notes: Never add remains, a death sound or narration that converts fear into fact.

setup: The protagonist carries one movable water source as part of his ordinary survival kit.
initial_audience_interpretation: It is routine utility equipment and possible fire protection.
payoff: Moving it among separated roof fronts fails; relocating it to the stone drain creates the concentrated rescue route.
notes: Test retrieval and flow so the limitation is time and coverage rather than an invented rule.

setup: Block damage, marker positions and objects accumulate consistently rather than resetting.
initial_audience_interpretation: The portal may still permit another attempt with a new outcome.
payoff: The fire creates the same ruin and the final ridge action creates the same sighting already observed.
notes: No scene may depict alternative results or an invisible correction.

setup: An ordinary-looking frame routes entry from discovery to aftermath and then to a pre-frame ejection.
initial_audience_interpretation: Builder identity may explain both construction and the temporal property’s first origin.
payoff: The protagonist is confirmed as physical builder, while the first source of the copied temporal routing remains unanswered.
intentionally_open_reason: The unexplained design-information loop supports the authorship theme and is not required to cause the fire, rescue or identity resolution.
notes: This open status remains a proposal pending human approval.
